errorCodes.meaning: All four key parts were supplied (exact fetch) and no record exists for that entity+authority+action+resource key. A partially keyed enumeration never raises this — it returns an empty page instead.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

RecordType.description: Whether the record asserts an authorization or a recognition relationship.
RecordType.title: RecordType

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as the request's `cursor`. Absent on the last page and on a fully keyed fetch — never null.

records.description: The matching trust records. Exactly one entry on a fully keyed fetch; zero or more per page on an enumeration.

authorized.description: Present on authorization records: whether the action+resource authorization is confirmed.

context.description: Opaque governance context attached to the record.

recognized.description: Present on recognition records: whether the action+resource is recognised.

validFrom.description: The first instant at which the authority statement holds (inclusive). Absent: no lower bound.

validUntil.description: The instant at which the authority statement stops holding (exclusive). Absent: no upper bound. When both bounds are present, `validFrom` MUST be earlier than `validUntil`.

schema.description: An administrator queries a trust registry's stored records by an optional four-part key. All four parts supplied: an exact fetch of one record (notFound on a miss). Fewer parts: a filtered, cursor-paginated enumeration — fixing the pagination gap the superseded registry/record/list conceded. Members are lowerCamelCase, as throughout the registry/* family.

action.description: Filter to records for this action.

authorityId.description: Filter to records asserted by this authority.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

entityId.description: Filter to records for this entity.

limit.description: Page size; the registry clamps to 1..=200 (default 50). Ignored on a fully keyed exact fetch.

resource.description: Filter to records for this resource.

schema.title: Registry Record Query — payload
